Top-level summary:
  Report that lists open sales orders by Sales Organization and date range and displays them via ALV.
  Main tables: VBAK, VBAP, VBUK, KNA1 (+ CDS I_SalesOrder).
  Authorizations: S_TCODE=ZSDR01, S_TABU_DIS=VBAK.

Next options:
  • "Regenerate as Excel"
  • "Extend to L4 with Where-used"
  • "Add an English version"
```
</Output_Format>

<MCP_Tools_Used>
- `SearchObject`, `GetObjectInfo`
- `GetProgFullCode`, `GetIncludesList`, `GetInclude`
- `ReadClass`, `ReadFunctionModule`, `ReadInterface`, `ReadView`
- `Read BehaviorDefinition`, `Read BehaviorImplementation`, `Read ServiceDefinition`, `Read ServiceBinding`
- `GetLocalDefinitions`, `GetLocalMacros`, `GetLocalTestClass`, `GetLocalTypes`
- `GetScreensList`, `GetGuiStatusList`, `GetTextElement`
- `GetMetadataExtension`
- `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`
- `GetWhereUsed`, `GetEnhancements`, `GetEnhancementSpot`
</MCP_Tools_Used>

<Related_Skills>
- `/sc4sap:analyze-code` — code quality review (what's wrong)
- `/sc4sap:create-program` — spec → new program (forward direction)
- `/sc4sap:deep-interview` — requirement clarification for new builds
</Related_Skills>

<Data_Extraction_Safety>
Spec generation only reads **source code + DDIC metadata + where-used** — never `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery`. No row data is extracted. The blocklist hook is respected if the user asks for sample data (refuse and document the request in the `Risk` sheet instead).
</Data_Extraction_Safety>

<Inputs_And_Screens_Rendering>
**Universal applicability (v8.1):** the image pipeline runs for **every xlsx spec** regardless of language (ko / en / ja / de / …) and depth (**L1 / L2 / L3 / L4**). Driver is language-agnostic — just populate `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` (+ optional `SHEET_TITLE`) constants at the top of the per-spec driver, and the template's internal `buildImages()` helper auto-imports `screen-image-renderer.mjs`, renders both PNGs, and embeds them via `build({ images })`. **No driver edits to the build call are required.**

**Parallel rendering:** `renderScreenImages()` in `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` uses `Promise.all` to spawn two headless browsers concurrently — Selection + ALV rasterize in parallel. Wall-clock cost is ~3s for both (vs ~6s sequential on Windows/Edge). Each branch is independent: if one rasterize fails or hits the 30s timeout, its PNG becomes null and the template falls back to cell-border wireframe for **that section only** — the other PNG still embeds, spec still opens.

**Fallback wireframe (auto):** when headless browser missing OR rasterize fails, `screensSheet()` in the template detects `hasSelectionImg` / `hasAlvImg` are false and draws cell-border wireframes from the same `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` via `renderSelectionWireframe` / `renderAlvWireframe` — readers always see the layout, never an empty sheet.

Mandatory content rules (propagate to every per-spec driver):
- **ALV sample rows ≤ 3** (up to 5 only when demonstrating lock / edit / mixed-status variants). Never dump more — the image is a mockup, not a data extract.
- **Color palette = grey + yellow only**. Headers, title bars, table captions use **light grey** (fill 2). Yellow (fill 3 / style 20) is reserved for warning rows. Green fill is retired.
- **Yellow warning rows MUST sit at the BOTTOM** of the `Inputs & Screens` sheet — readers scan top→bottom.
- **Informational rows** (Flow diagram, BAPI / Action mapping) above the Parameters table use minimal formatting.
- **Localise `SHEET_TITLE` + `INPUTS_SHEET_NAME`** for ko/ja specs — `build()` warns (no silent drop) if `images[].sheetName` drifts from the final workbook sheet name.

Markdown output — unchanged: continue emitting ASCII wireframes inside fenced code blocks. ASCII wireframes never go in xlsx cells.
</Inputs_And_Screens_Rendering>

**Context**: Generating Excel specification for ZMMRTEST003 (Sales Order Query Report).

**Specification scope**: L2 Standard depth, Korean (한국어), Excel format, Audience: Both (Functional + Technical)

**Object details**:
- Type: ABAP Report (SALV ALV output)
- Purpose: Lists open sales orders by Sales Organization and date range
- Selection params: Sales Organization (required), Created Date (required), Distribution Channel (optional), Customer (optional), Sales Document (optional)
- Output: ALV grid with 10 columns (VBELN, KUNNR, NAME1, NETWR, POSNR, MATNR, MAKTX, KWMENG, VRKME, NETWR_I), aggregate summations on NETWR/KWMENG/NETWR_I, hotspot drill-down to VA03
- Main tables: VBAK, VBAP, KNA1, MAKT

**Task**: Produce the complete JSON structure (as a code block) for the rich-xlsx-template.mjs driver. Include:

1. **SHEETS_DATA**: Array of 5 sheets
   - 개요 (Overview): Business purpose, key features, main tables
   - 데이터 모델 (Data Model): Table structure, field definitions
   - 입력 (Inputs): Selection screen parameters
   - 처리 로직 (Processing Logic): Main logic flow (joined with PROCESS_FLOW steps)
   - 오류 및 예외 (Error Handling): Authority checks, validation rules
   
   Each sheet has `{ name, rows: [[header row], [data rows...]], colWidths? }`
   Use Korean sheet names. Ensure rows fit within column width constraints (no cell truncation).

2. **PROCESS_FLOW**: Array of 11 numbered processing steps (in Korean) describing the program flow from initialization through hotspot event handling and transaction call.

3. **SCREEN_PARAMS**: Array of 5 parameter objects with required/optional flags and Korean descriptions:
   - S_VKORG (Sales Organization)
   - S_ERDAT (Created Date)
   - S_VTWEG (Distribution Channel)
   - S_KUNNR (Customer)
   - S_VBELN (Sales Document)

4. **SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC**: Selection screen spec with:
   - blockLabel: Korean title
   - 2 required fields (VKORG range, ERDAT date range)
   - 3 optional fields (VTWEG, KUNNR, VBELN)
   - field structure: { required?, label, name, range?, defaultLow?, defaultHigh?, note? }

5. **ALV_IMAGE_SPEC**: ALV grid spec with:
   - 10 columns (VBELN, KUNNR, NAME1, NETWR, POSNR, MATNR, MAKTX, KWMENG, VRKME, NETWR_I)
   - 3 sample rows with realistic Korean company data (삼성전자, LG그룹, 현대자동차, etc.)
   - Column metadata: { name, header (Korean), width, align?, hotspot?, editable? }
   - sampleRow format: { [colName]: value, _status?: '●'|'○'|'◉' }

6. **WARNINGS**: Array of 2 caution rows (yellow-shaded) with Korean text:
   - 취소/반품 필터링 부재 (Missing cancellation/return filtering)
   - 기간 성능 리스크 (Date range performance risk for large queries)

   - SHEET_TITLE: "입력 및 화면 · ZMMRTEST003"
   - INPUTS_SHEET_NAME: "입력 및 화면"
   - SCREEN_PARAMS_TITLE: "파라미터"
   - SCREEN_PARAMS_HEADERS: ["필드", "타입", "필수", "기본값", "설명"]
   - SPEC_LANG: "ko"
   - OUT_PATH: ".sc4sap/specs/ZMMRTEST003-20260520-ko.xlsx"

**Output format**: Provide ONLY the JSON code block (properly formatted, no explanation text before/after). This is a direct drop-in for the TODO blocks in the template driver. content.text: 기존 ZMMR1001 spec에서 프로그램 정보를 가져옵니다.

content.content:
1	# Specification: ZMMR1001
2	
3	- **오브젝트 유형**: PROG/P (Report)
4	- **패키지**: ZMM_PAEK
5	- **아키텍처**: Split ALV Report (OOP) — `lcl_data` / `lcl_alv` / `lcl_event`
6	- **인클루드**: 없음 (단일 파일)
7	- **스크린**: 1000 (선택화면) · 0100 (ALV Docking 출력화면)
8	- **GUI Status**: 없음
9	- **스펙 깊이**: L2 Standard · 언어: 한국어 · 작성일: 2026-05-05
10	
11	---
12	
13	## 1. 비즈니스 목적
14	
15	플랜트별 자재유형 `HALB`(반제품) 자재를 조회하여 **Split ALV 마스터-디테일** 형태로 표시하는 읽기 전용 리포트.  
16	상단 그리드에 자재번호(MATNR) 목록을 표시하고, 행을 더블클릭하면 하단 그리드에 해당 자재의 상세 정보(자재내역 / 플랜트 / 기본단위 / 자재유형)가 즉시 갱신된다.  
17	데이터 변경 없음(100% READ-ONLY). 조회 결과는 최대 50건으로 제한(`gc_rowlimit = 50`).
18	
19	---
20	
21	## 2. 데이터 모델
22	
23	| 테이블 | 별칭 | R/W | 조인 방식 | 필터 조건 | 설명 |
24	|--------|------|-----|-----------|-----------|------|
25	| `MARA` | `a` | READ | Driving table | `MTART = 'HALB'` | 자재 마스터 일반 (자재번호, 기본단위, 자재유형) |
26	| `MARC` | `b` | READ | INNER JOIN `b~matnr = a~matnr` | `WERKS = p_werks` | 자재 마스터 플랜트 (플랜트별 할당) |
27	| `MAKT` | `t` | READ | LEFT OUTER JOIN `t~matnr = a~matnr AND t~spras = sy-langu` | 로그온 언어(`sy-langu`) | 자재 내역 텍스트 (자재명, 없으면 NULL 허용) |
28	
29	**SQL 특성**: 단일 SELECT · 3-table JOIN · `ORDER BY a~matnr` · `UP TO 50 ROWS`  
30	**내부 구조**:
31	
32	| 변수 | 타입 | 용도 |
33	|------|------|------|
34	| `gt_data` | `tt_data` (SORTED TABLE BY matnr) | 마스터 캐시 — 전체 조회 결과 |
35	| `gt_list` | `tt_list` (STANDARD TABLE) | 상단 그리드용 distinct MATNR 목록 |
36	| `gt_detail` | `tt_detail` (STANDARD TABLE) | 하단 그리드용 선택 자재 상세 |
37	
38	---
39	
40	## 3. 입력 및 화면
41	
42	### 3.1 파라미터
43	
44	| 파라미터 | 타입 | 필수 | 기본값 | 설명 |
45	|----------|------|------|--------|------|
46	| `P_WERKS` | `MARC-WERKS` (CHAR 4) | OBLIGATORY | — | 플랜트 코드. 화면 라벨: `TEXT-s01` (INITIALIZATION에서 동적 설정). 블록 B01 (FRAME TITLE = `TEXT-b01`). |
47	
48	### 3.2 선택화면 1000
49	
50	```
51	┌─ ◆ 조회 조건 (B01) ──────────────────────────────────────┐
52	│  * 플랜트 (P_WERKS)  [____] [▼]                           │
53	└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
54	  [F8 실행]  [F3 뒤로]
55	```
56	
57	- `P_WERKS`: 4자리 플랜트 코드, 필수 입력(OBLIGATORY)
58	- F8 Execute → `START-OF-SELECTION` 진입
59	
60	### 3.3 출력화면 0100 — Split ALV (Docking + Splitter)
61	
62	```
63	┌─ ALV Docking Container (dock_at_top, extension=4000) ────────────────────┐
64	│ ┌─ 상단 그리드 (gt_list, TEXT-t01, height=40%, sel_mode='B') ───────────┐ │
65	│ │  자재번호                                                              │ │
66	│ │  ──────────────────                                                    │ │
67	│ │  HALB-001234                                                           │ │
68	│ │  HALB-005678           ← 더블클릭 시 하단 갱신                         │ │
69	│ │  HALB-009012                                                           │ │
70	│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
71	│ ┌─ 하단 그리드 (gt_detail, TEXT-t02 — 예: 상단 HALB-001234 클릭 시) ────┐ │
72	│ │  자재 내역                  │ 플랜트 │ 기본단위 │ 자재유형              │ │
73	│ │  ────────────────────────  │ ────── │ ──────── │ ────────              │ │
74	│ │  반제품 조립체 A — 1000    │  1000  │    EA    │  HALB                 │ │
75	│ │  반제품 조립체 A — 2000    │  2000  │    EA    │  HALB                 │ │
76	│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
77	└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
78	```
79	
80	### 3.4 화면 흐름
81	
82	```mermaid
83	flowchart LR
84	  A[선택화면 1000\nP_WERKS 입력] -->|F8 실행| B[출력화면 0100\nSplit ALV]
85	  B -->|상단 행 더블클릭| C[하단 그리드 갱신\ngt_detail 재구성]
86	  C --> B
87	  B -->|Back / Exit\nsy-subrc ≠ 0| D[go_alv→free\n종료]
88	```
89	
90	---
91	
92	## 4. 처리 로직 (단계별)
93

# Specification: ZMMR1001

- **오브젝트 유형**: PROG/P (Report)
- **패키지**: ZMM_PAEK
- **아키텍처**: Split ALV Report (OOP) — `lcl_data` / `lcl_alv` / `lcl_event`
- **인클루드**: 없음 (단일 파일)
- **스크린**: 1000 (선택화면) · 0100 (ALV Docking 출력화면)
- **GUI Status**: 없음
- **스펙 깊이**: L2 Standard · 언어: 한국어 · 작성일: 2026-05-05

---

## 1. 비즈니스 목적

플랜트별 자재유형 `HALB`(반제품) 자재를 조회하여 **Split ALV 마스터-디테일** 형태로 표시하는 읽기 전용 리포트.  
상단 그리드에 자재번호(MATNR) 목록을 표시하고, 행을 더블클릭하면 하단 그리드에 해당 자재의 상세 정보(자재내역 / 플랜트 / 기본단위 / 자재유형)가 즉시 갱신된다.  
데이터 변경 없음(100% READ-ONLY). 조회 결과는 최대 50건으로 제한(`gc_rowlimit = 50`).

---

## 2. 데이터 모델

| 테이블 | 별칭 | R/W | 조인 방식 | 필터 조건 | 설명 |
|--------|------|-----|-----------|-----------|------|
| `MARA` | `a` | READ | Driving table | `MTART = 'HALB'` | 자재 마스터 일반 (자재번호, 기본단위, 자재유형) |
| `MARC` | `b` | READ | INNER JOIN `b~matnr = a~matnr` | `WERKS = p_werks` | 자재 마스터 플랜트 (플랜트별 할당) |
| `MAKT` | `t` | READ | LEFT OUTER JOIN `t~matnr = a~matnr AND t~spras = sy-langu` | 로그온 언어(`sy-langu`) | 자재 내역 텍스트 (자재명, 없으면 NULL 허용) |

**SQL 특성**: 단일 SELECT · 3-table JOIN · `ORDER BY a~matnr` · `UP TO 50 ROWS`  
**내부 구조**:

| 변수 | 타입 | 용도 |
|------|------|------|
| `gt_data` | `tt_data` (SORTED TABLE BY matnr) | 마스터 캐시 — 전체 조회 결과 |
| `gt_list` | `tt_list` (STANDARD TABLE) | 상단 그리드용 distinct MATNR 목록 |
| `gt_detail` | `tt_detail` (STANDARD TABLE) | 하단 그리드용 선택 자재 상세 |

---

## 3. 입력 및 화면

### 3.1 파라미터

| 파라미터 | 타입 | 필수 | 기본값 | 설명 |
|----------|------|------|--------|------|
| `P_WERKS` | `MARC-WERKS` (CHAR 4) | OBLIGATORY | — | 플랜트 코드. 화면 라벨: `TEXT-s01` (INITIALIZATION에서 동적 설정). 블록 B01 (FRAME TITLE = `TEXT-b01`). |

### 3.2 선택화면 1000

```
┌─ ◆ 조회 조건 (B01) ──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  * 플랜트 (P_WERKS)  [____] [▼]                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  [F8 실행]  [F3 뒤로]
```

- `P_WERKS`: 4자리 플랜트 코드, 필수 입력(OBLIGATORY)
- F8 Execute → `START-OF-SELECTION` 진입

### 3.3 출력화면 0100 — Split ALV (Docking + Splitter)

```
┌─ ALV Docking Container (dock_at_top, extension=4000) ────────────────────┐
│ ┌─ 상단 그리드 (gt_list, TEXT-t01, height=40%, sel_mode='B') ───────────┐ │
│ │  자재번호                                                              │ │
│ │  ──────────────────                                                    │ │
│ │  HALB-001234                                                           │ │
│ │  HALB-005678           ← 더블클릭 시 하단 갱신                         │ │
│ │  HALB-009012                                                           │ │
│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ ┌─ 하단 그리드 (gt_detail, TEXT-t02 — 예: 상단 HALB-001234 클릭 시) ────┐ │
│ │  자재 내역                  │ 플랜트 │ 기본단위 │ 자재유형              │ │
│ │  ────────────────────────  │ ────── │ ──────── │ ────────              │ │
│ │  반제품 조립체 A — 1000    │  1000  │    EA    │  HALB                 │ │
│ │  반제품 조립체 A — 2000    │  2000  │    EA    │  HALB                 │ │
│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 3.4 화면 흐름

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[선택화면 1000\nP_WERKS 입력] -->|F8 실행| B[출력화면 0100\nSplit ALV]
  B -->|상단 행 더블클릭| C[하단 그리드 갱신\ngt_detail 재구성]
  C --> B
  B -->|Back / Exit\nsy-subrc ≠ 0| D[go_alv→free\n종료]
```

---

## 4. 처리 로직 (단계별)

| # | 이벤트 / 단계 | 설명 |
|---|--------------|------|
| 1 | `INITIALIZATION` | `%_p_werks_%_app_%-text = TEXT-s01` — P_WERKS 화면 라벨 동적 설정 |
| 2 | `START-OF-SELECTION` | `go_data = NEW lcl_data( )` 인스턴스 생성 |
| 3 | `START-OF-SELECTION` → `authorize()` | `AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'M_MATE_WRK'` (WERKS=p_werks, ACTVT='03'). 실패 시 `MESSAGE 'Not authorized' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'` → `RETURN` |
| 4 | `START-OF-SELECTION` → `fetch()` | MARA ⋈ MARC ⋈ MAKT 3-table JOIN, `ORDER BY a~matnr`, `UP TO 50 ROWS`. `et_data`(전체) + `et_list`(distinct MATNR) 반환 |
| 5 | `START-OF-SELECTION` | `gt_data IS INITIAL` → `MESSAGE s013(s_unified_con) DISPLAY LIKE 'E'` → `RETURN` |

| 더블클릭 행 미존재 | — | — | `CHECK sy-subrc = 0` — 조용히 skip |

## 8. 의존성 및 로컬 클래스

### 8.1 로컬 클래스 메서드 시그니처

**`lcl_data`** — 데이터 액세스 (권한 + 조회)

| 메서드 | IMPORTING | EXPORTING | RETURNING |
|--------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| `authorize` | `iv_werks TYPE marc-werks` | — | `rv_ok TYPE abap_bool` |
| `fetch` | `iv_werks TYPE marc-werks` | `et_data TYPE tt_data`, `et_list TYPE tt_list` | — |

**`lcl_alv`** — ALV UI 컨트롤러

| 메서드 | 가시성 | 반환 |
|--------|--------|------|
| `constructor` | PUBLIC | — |
| `display_initial` | PUBLIC | — |
| `refresh_bottom` | PUBLIC | — |
| `free` | PUBLIC | — |
| `build_fcat_top` | PRIVATE | `rt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat` |
| `build_fcat_bot` | PRIVATE | `rt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat` |

**`lcl_event`** — ALV 이벤트 핸들러

| 메서드 | FOR EVENT | IMPORTING |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| `on_double_click` | `double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid` | `e_row`, `e_column` |

### 8.2 SAP 표준 클래스 사용

| 클래스 | 용도 |
|--------|------|
| `cl_gui_docking_container` | Docking 컨테이너 (화면 상단 고정, extension=4000) |
| `cl_gui_splitter_container` | 2-row 수직 분할 컨테이너 (rows=2, columns=1) |
| `cl_gui_alv_grid` | 상단/하단 각각 1개씩 인스턴스 생성 |
| `cl_salv_table` | fieldcat 자동 생성용 (`factory` + `get_lvc_fieldcatalog`) |

### 8.3 파라미터

```abap
SCREEN_PARAMS:
  P_WERKS  TYPE MARC-WERKS  OBLIGATORY
             -- PARAMETERS 선언, 블록 B01
```

content.content:
1	# Program → Spec — Workflow Steps
2	
3	Referenced by `SKILL.md`. Follow these 6 steps (Step 0 through Step 5) whenever the skill runs.
4	
5	**Step 0 — Socratic interview** (see `Socratic_Scope_Narrowing` section in `SKILL.md`)
6	Default opener: issue ONE bundled `AskUserQuestion` call with the four standard questions — **Audience / Format / Depth / Language** — in that exact order, each single-select with the "(Recommended)" option first. This is MANDATORY whenever the target object is already present in `ARGUMENTS`; it replaces Rounds 2+3+5 in a single UI turn.
7	Fall back to per-round questioning only when (a) the object is missing/ambiguous (run Round 1 first) or (b) the user picks L3/L4 in the bundle (run Round 4 scope-trimming after).
8	Never skip entirely unless the user supplies `object=... depth=L2 format=md lang=ko` style fully-qualified arguments.
9	
10	**Step 1 — Inventory** (auto, parallel MCP calls)
11	- `SearchObject` — confirm object + sub-type
12	- Metadata: `GetObjectInfo` — package, author, created/changed, transport
13	
14	**Step 1.5 — CBO inventory lookup** (auto)
15	- Resolve `<PACKAGE>` from `GetObjectInfo` above.
16	- Ask the user one question: "Which module does package `<PACKAGE>` belong to? (SD / MM / PP / PM / QM / WM / TM / TR / FI / CO / HCM / BW / PS / Ariba)" — only if the module cannot be derived from `.sc4sap/config.json` or the package's existing CBO folder.
17	- Check `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/inventory.json`.
18	  - **Exists** → Load it. When the analyst describes data sources, tables, or helper calls in Step 3, annotate each one that matches an inventory entry with its CBO role + one-line business purpose (e.g., "writes to `ZSD_ORDER_LOG` — append-only sales-order processing log"). This turns opaque Z-references in the spec into named reusable assets.
19	  - **Missing** → Print one line: "No CBO inventory at `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/`. Run `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` first for richer spec annotations, or type `skip` to proceed."
20	- Persist the loaded entries to `.sc4sap/specs/<OBJECT>/cbo-context.md` so sap-analyst and sap-writer consume it in Step 3.
21	- Source:
22	  - Report/Program: `GetProgFullCode` + `GetIncludesList` → iterate `GetInclude`
23	  - Class: `ReadClass` (all sections) + `GetLocalDefinitions` / `GetLocalMacros` / `GetLocalTestClass` / `GetLocalTypes`
24	  - Function Module: `ReadFunctionModule` + function group includes
25	  - CDS: `ReadView` + `GetMetadataExtension`
26	  - RAP: `Read BehaviorDefinition` + `Read BehaviorImplementation` + `Read ServiceDefinition` + `Read ServiceBinding`
27	- Screens / GUI Status / Text Elements (if report / module pool): `GetScreensList`, `GetGuiStatusList`, `GetTextElement`
28	- Structural: `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`
29	- Enhancements (L3+): `GetEnhancements`, `GetEnhancementSpot`
30	- Where-Used (L4 only — fixed scope): `GetWhereUsed` against the main object **plus each screen**; filter callers to customer namespace `Z*` / `Y*` only. Skip standard SAP and add-on namespaces.
31	
32	**Step 2 — Classify** (auto)
33	- Object archetype: ALV report / batch job / BDC / FM wrapper / CDS view / RAP BO / enhancement impl / utility class
34	- Drives which spec template is applied in Step 3.
35	
36	**Step 3 — Delegate to sap-analyst + sap-writer** (+ sap-critic on L4)
37	
38	Emit Phase Banner before each dispatch (see `SKILL.md` § Phase_Banner):
39	
40	```
41	▶ phase=3.analyst · agent=sap-analyst · model=Opus 4.7
42	▶ phase=3.writer · agent=sap-writer · model=<Haiku 4.5 for L1/L2 | Sonnet 4.6 override for L3/L4>
43	▶ phase=3.critic (L4 only) · agent=sap-critic · model=Opus 4.7
44	```
45	
46	- **sap-analyst** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) extracts: business purpose, inputs (selection screen / importing params), outputs (ALV cols / exporting params / OData entity), data sources (tables + CDS + BAPIs), main logic narrative, error cases, authorization checks (`AUTHORITY-CHECK` statements). When `cbo-context.md` exists, the analyst cross-references every Z-object mentioned against the inventory and replaces opaque "Z-table" / "Z-class" labels with the inventory's documented role + business purpose.
47	- **sap-writer** (Haiku 4.5 base; **`model: "sonnet"` override for L3/L4 depth** — longer narrative + deeper cross-reference + stronger consistency requirement) renders into the chosen format (MD or Excel) at the chosen depth + language.
48	- **sap-critic** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) gate (only if L4): verifies every claim cross-references a line range.
49	
50	**Step 3.5 — Draw screens (MANDATORY when screens exist)**
51	
52	Every Selection-Screen and every output Screen (Dynpro) / ALV must be rendered as a **visual wireframe**, not just described in prose. Use this tiered approach:
53	
54	1. **ASCII wireframe** — **Markdown output only**. Works inside fenced code blocks where character widths are guaranteed uniform. **Never** put ASCII box-drawing characters (`┌─┐│└┘├┤┬┴┼`) into Excel cells — Excel column widths don't match character widths, so vertical lines misalign and the mock breaks visually. For Excel use real cell borders instead (see the Excel render pipeline in Step 4).
55	   - Reconstruct layout from `GetScreen` / `ReadScreen` (`HEADER` + `FLOW_LOGIC` + field positions `LINE` / `COLUMN` / `LENGTH` / `HEIGHT`) for Dynpros.
56	   - Reconstruct Selection-Screen from `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` / `SELECTION-SCREEN BLOCK` statements in the source.
57	   - Reconstruct ALV output from the field catalog (columns + widths + headings).
58	   - Show label + input box + F4-help marker `[▼]` + mandatory `*`.
59	2. **Embedded PNG mockup (v8.1 PRIMARY PATH for xlsx — all languages, L1~L4)** — **xlsx output**. Selection Screen and ALV layout are rendered as SVG → PNG **in parallel** (Promise.all → two concurrent headless-browser spawns) via `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` and embedded through `build({ images })` in `rich-xlsx-template.mjs`. **Drivers do not call the renderer directly** — they only populate `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` / `SHEET_TITLE` constants; the template's `buildImages()` helper + top-level `await` does the rest. `alv.maxRows` is **3 (absolute max 5)**. When rasterization returns null (no headless Edge/Chrome) or times out (30s cap), `screensSheet()` auto-draws cell-border wireframes from the same specs via `renderSelectionWireframe` / `renderAlvWireframe` — never silently omit the screens.
60	3. **Mermaid diagram** (MD output only, when flow matters):
61	   - `flowchart TD` for screen-to-screen navigation (CALL SCREEN / LEAVE TO / SET SCREEN).
62	   - `classDiagram` for GUI Status menubar/toolbar/function-key mapping.
63	   - In Excel, the same flow is drawn as style-21 bordered-box cells connected by plain-text arrows.
64	4. **Classical Dynpro** → include header line (short description, next-screen, cursor-pos) + flow-logic pseudo-code (`PBO` / `PAI` modules).
65	5. **GUI Status** → render menubar / application toolbar / function keys as a short table (FKEY → FCODE → text) plus (in MD) an ASCII toolbar bar.
66	
67	Artifacts produced in this step are placed in the `Inputs & Screens` section (MD §8) or `Inputs & Screens` sheet (Excel). The **Parameters table (§8.1) is always rendered** — for objects without UI (pure class, FM, CDS, RAP without screens), skip only the wireframe tiers (§8.2–§8.4) and keep the Parameters table.
68	
69	**Step 4 — Render**
70	- **Markdown**: single `.md` with H2 sections per spec dimension, tables for selection-screen / tables / methods / exits.
71	- **Excel (MANDATORY workflow — standalone rich driver, throwaway)**:
72	
73	  > **Why a throwaway driver?** The minimal `scripts/spec/build-xlsx.mjs` writer only emits plain text cells — it cannot draw Dynpro frames with real borders, merged cells, or fixed column widths. Without those, Selection-Screen wireframes rendered as ASCII art inside Excel cells break visually (column widths ≠ character widths, vertical lines misalign). So for every Excel spec we generate a **per-spec standalone driver** at a temp path, run it once, then delete it. The driver carries its own rich writer (styles.xml / borders / merges / col widths) plus the spec-specific content inline — nothing to import, nothing to configure, nothing shared between specs.
74	
75	  Pipeline for each Excel-output spec:
76	
77	  1. **Copy the template** `scripts/spec/rich-xlsx-template.mjs` to a per-spec driver path:
78	     - Default: `.sc4sap/specs/_drivers/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.mjs`
79	     - If the user specified an absolute output directory (e.g. `C:\Users\...\Desktop\test`), put the driver next to the target xlsx — it makes cleanup obvious and avoids cluttering the project.
80	  2. **Fill the TODO blocks** inside the copy, using the content produced by sap-analyst + sap-writer in Step 3:
81	     - `SHEETS_DATA` — array of `{ name, rows: [[header...], [row...], ...] }` for text sheets (Overview, Data Model, Logic, Outputs, Authorization, Exceptions, plus L3 sheets — Enhancements / Includes & Artifacts; plus L4 sheets — Where-Used / Risk). The Parameters table lives inside the `Inputs & Screens` sheet and is produced by `screensSheet()` (see below), not as an independent text sheet.
82	     - `SCREEN_PARAMS` — Parameters table rows (field / type / required / default / description). Always populated even when the object has no selection screen (pure FM / Class / CDS / RAP).
83	     - `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` (new in v8.1) — selection-screen field list. Drives BOTH the PNG image path AND the cell-border wireframe fallback. Leave `null` for objects without a selection screen. Shape: `{ blockLabel, fields: [{ required?, label, name, range?, note? }], optionBlockLabel?, optionFields?: [{ label, name, note? }] }`. NOTE (v8.3): `defaultLow` / `defaultHigh` are silently ignored inside the input-box graphic — the field name already labels the box, and stuffing "BOM" / "1000" / "오늘" inside just adds visual noise. Put any default value either in the `note` field (rendered to the right of the row) or in the Parameters table below. The label column also auto-widens to fit the longest label, so long English names like `Distribution Channel (S_VTWEG)` no longer collide with the input box.
84	     - `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` (v8.1, multi-pane in v10) — ALV layout spec. Two shapes accepted: **(legacy single-grid)** `{ columns, sampleRows, maxRows }` — same as before; **(multi-pane v10)** `{ layout: 'split-vertical' | 'split-horizontal' | 'tabstrip', interaction: '상단 더블클릭 → 하단 갱신', panes: [{ title, columns, sampleRows, maxRows }, ...] }` for Split-ALV / Tabstrip / Sequence layouts. Use multi-pane whenever a Docking + Splitter container hosts ≥2 grids OR a tabstrip carries different grids per page — single-grid PNG cannot capture the click-to-drill flow. **Every pane MUST carry realistic `sampleRows`** showing what the user sees AFTER the trigger fires (e.g. for ZMMR1001's bottom pane: the MAKTX/WERKS/MEINS/MTART row that appears after double-clicking a top-pane MATNR). The `interaction` caption above the pane explains WHEN/HOW it appears; the populated rows show WHAT appears. **Do not leave panes empty with placeholder text** — readers can't infer the layout/columns from prose, and the spec loses gradient. `placeholder` field exists ONLY as a last-resort affordance for grids whose content is genuinely unrenderable (popup variants, variable BAdI output) — prefer 1-2 sample rows + a `subtitle` like `'예시: 상단 HALB-001234 클릭 시'` over `placeholder`. maxRows capped at 5, default 3. NOTE (v8.3): the legend under each grid is auto-derived from that pane's spec — Hotspot/Editable/traffic-light items only render when applicable.
85	     - `SHEET_TITLE` (new in v8.1) — localised row-1 title of `Inputs & Screens` sheet (e.g. `'입력 및 화면 · ZMM_0001'` for KO, `'入力と画面 · ZMM_0001'` for JA).
86	     - `INPUTS_SHEET_NAME` — localised workbook tab name (e.g. `'입력 및 화면'` for KO). Must stay ≤ 31 chars (xlsx limit).
87	     - `SPEC_LANG` (new in v8.3) — output language for the auto-derived legends inside the PNG mockups. One of `'ko' | 'en' | 'ja'`; defaults to `'ko'`. An English-language spec MUST set `'en'` or the bottom legends will render as `필수 입력 · ▼ 복수 선택 · ~ 범위(LOW~HIGH)` even though the surrounding prose is English.
88	     - `WARNINGS` (new in v8.3) — array of program-specific yellow caveat rows (style 20, merged A:Q, pinned to the BOTTOM of the `Inputs & Screens` sheet). These are **not** boilerplate — fill with the analyst's actual findings, one caveat per string, prefixed with `⚠`. Leave `[]` for a clean spec. Categories to consider: Authorization gaps, Runtime / data-volume risk, Dependency coupling (called TCodes, BAPIs), PII exposure, Error-path gaps (missing CATCH). Empty array = no yellow rows rendered.
89	     - `PROCESS_FLOW` (new in v8.4) — vertical flowchart auto-appended below the `Processing Logic` data table (sheet name matched via `PROCESS_FLOW_SHEET`, default `'Processing Logic'`). Each entry is one node string. Conventions: plain text → bordered box (style 21); `?` prefix → decision (yellow style 20, prefix replaced with `◇ `); `!` prefix → terminal/exit marker (bordered, prefix replaced with `■ `). Decisions can fold a single branch into the same row using ` → ` (e.g. `'? gt_result IS INITIAL → MESSAGE + LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING'`). The renderer inserts a centered `↓` arrow row (style 25 — no border / no fill) between consecutive nodes. Localise `PROCESS_FLOW_HEADING` per language (default `'Process Flow Chart'`; KO `'프로세스 플로우 차트'`, JA `'プロセスフロー'`). Empty array = no flowchart rendered (heading also skipped). The flowchart ALWAYS sits AFTER the numbered step table — the table is the authoritative source, the chart is a navigation aid.
90	     - **Automatic image pipeline** — drivers do NOT manually import `renderScreenImages` and do NOT edit the `build()` call. The template's internal `buildImages()` + top-level `await` runs automatically: (a) renders Selection + ALV PNGs **in parallel** via headless browser, (b) falls back to `screensSheet()` cell-border wireframes per section when rasterize returns null or times out. No driver action needed beyond populating the two SPEC constants.
91	     - **Never** place ASCII box-drawing characters (`┌─┐│└┘├┤┬┴┼`) inside data cells.
92	     - `OUT_PATH` — absolute path the user asked for (or the default `.sc4sap/specs/{object}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.xlsx`).
93	  3. **Run the driver**:
94	     ```bash
95	     node <driver>.mjs
96	     ```
97	     The driver writes the xlsx and auto-opens it in the OS default handler (Excel / LibreOffice) — the built-in `openInDefault()` spawns `cmd.exe /c start "" <path>` on Windows, `open` on macOS, `xdg-open` on Linux, detached + `unref()`'d so Claude Code doesn't block.

# Program → Spec — Workflow Steps

Referenced by `SKILL.md`. Follow these 6 steps (Step 0 through Step 5) whenever the skill runs.

**Step 0 — Socratic interview** (see `Socratic_Scope_Narrowing` section in `SKILL.md`)
Default opener: issue ONE bundled `AskUserQuestion` call with the four standard questions — **Audience / Format / Depth / Language** — in that exact order, each single-select with the "(Recommended)" option first. This is MANDATORY whenever the target object is already present in `ARGUMENTS`; it replaces Rounds 2+3+5 in a single UI turn.
Fall back to per-round questioning only when (a) the object is missing/ambiguous (run Round 1 first) or (b) the user picks L3/L4 in the bundle (run Round 4 scope-trimming after).
Never skip entirely unless the user supplies `object=... depth=L2 format=md lang=ko` style fully-qualified arguments.

**Step 1 — Inventory** (auto, parallel MCP calls)
- `SearchObject` — confirm object + sub-type
- Metadata: `GetObjectInfo` — package, author, created/changed, transport

**Step 1.5 — CBO inventory lookup** (auto)
- Resolve `<PACKAGE>` from `GetObjectInfo` above.
- Ask the user one question: "Which module does package `<PACKAGE>` belong to? (SD / MM / PP / PM / QM / WM / TM / TR / FI / CO / HCM / BW / PS / Ariba)" — only if the module cannot be derived from `.sc4sap/config.json` or the package's existing CBO folder.
- Check `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/inventory.json`.
  - **Exists** → Load it. When the analyst describes data sources, tables, or helper calls in Step 3, annotate each one that matches an inventory entry with its CBO role + one-line business purpose (e.g., "writes to `ZSD_ORDER_LOG` — append-only sales-order processing log"). This turns opaque Z-references in the spec into named reusable assets.
  - **Missing** → Print one line: "No CBO inventory at `.sc4sap/cbo/<MODULE>/<PACKAGE>/`. Run `/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj` first for richer spec annotations, or type `skip` to proceed."
- Persist the loaded entries to `.sc4sap/specs/<OBJECT>/cbo-context.md` so sap-analyst and sap-writer consume it in Step 3.
- Source:
  - Report/Program: `GetProgFullCode` + `GetIncludesList` → iterate `GetInclude`
  - Class: `ReadClass` (all sections) + `GetLocalDefinitions` / `GetLocalMacros` / `GetLocalTestClass` / `GetLocalTypes`
  - Function Module: `ReadFunctionModule` + function group includes
  - CDS: `ReadView` + `GetMetadataExtension`
  - RAP: `Read BehaviorDefinition` + `Read BehaviorImplementation` + `Read ServiceDefinition` + `Read ServiceBinding`
- Screens / GUI Status / Text Elements (if report / module pool): `GetScreensList`, `GetGuiStatusList`, `GetTextElement`
- Structural: `GetAbapAST`, `GetAbapSemanticAnalysis`
- Enhancements (L3+): `GetEnhancements`, `GetEnhancementSpot`
- Where-Used (L4 only — fixed scope): `GetWhereUsed` against the main object **plus each screen**; filter callers to customer namespace `Z*` / `Y*` only. Skip standard SAP and add-on namespaces.

**Step 2 — Classify** (auto)
- Object archetype: ALV report / batch job / BDC / FM wrapper / CDS view / RAP BO / enhancement impl / utility class
- Drives which spec template is applied in Step 3.

**Step 3 — Delegate to sap-analyst + sap-writer** (+ sap-critic on L4)

Emit Phase Banner before each dispatch (see `SKILL.md` § Phase_Banner):

```
▶ phase=3.analyst · agent=sap-analyst · model=Opus 4.7
▶ phase=3.writer · agent=sap-writer · model=<Haiku 4.5 for L1/L2 | Sonnet 4.6 override for L3/L4>
▶ phase=3.critic (L4 only) · agent=sap-critic · model=Opus 4.7
```

- **sap-analyst** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) extracts: business purpose, inputs (selection screen / importing params), outputs (ALV cols / exporting params / OData entity), data sources (tables + CDS + BAPIs), main logic narrative, error cases, authorization checks (`AUTHORITY-CHECK` statements). When `cbo-context.md` exists, the analyst cross-references every Z-object mentioned against the inventory and replaces opaque "Z-table" / "Z-class" labels with the inventory's documented role + business purpose.
- **sap-writer** (Haiku 4.5 base; **`model: "sonnet"` override for L3/L4 depth** — longer narrative + deeper cross-reference + stronger consistency requirement) renders into the chosen format (MD or Excel) at the chosen depth + language.
- **sap-critic** (Opus 4.7, frontmatter) gate (only if L4): verifies every claim cross-references a line range.

**Step 3.5 — Draw screens (MANDATORY when screens exist)**

Every Selection-Screen and every output Screen (Dynpro) / ALV must be rendered as a **visual wireframe**, not just described in prose. Use this tiered approach:

1. **ASCII wireframe** — **Markdown output only**. Works inside fenced code blocks where character widths are guaranteed uniform. **Never** put ASCII box-drawing characters (`┌─┐│└┘├┤┬┴┼`) into Excel cells — Excel column widths don't match character widths, so vertical lines misalign and the mock breaks visually.    - Reconstruct Selection-Screen from `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` / `SELECTION-SCREEN BLOCK` statements in the source.
   - Reconstruct ALV output from the field catalog (columns + widths + headings).

2. **Embedded PNG mockup (v8.1 PRIMARY PATH for xlsx — all languages, L1~L4)** — **xlsx output**. 4. **Classical Dynpro** → include header line (short description, next-screen, cursor-pos) + flow-logic pseudo-code (`PBO` / `PAI` modules).

**Step 4 — Render**
- **Markdown**: single `.md` with H2 sections per spec dimension, tables for selection-screen / tables / methods / exits. See [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) for the section skeleton.

- **Excel (MANDATORY workflow — 양식 보존 / format-preserving template clone)**:

  > **Why clone, not build?** The previous "throwaway driver" workflow rebuilt the workbook geometry from JSON (SHEETS_DATA / SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC / ALV_IMAGE_SPEC / styles inline). It drifted from the agreed reference layout on every iteration — column widths, fonts, borders, image anchors all subtly off. To stop that drift, every Excel spec now CLONES `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and ONLY swaps `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. Styles, borders, fonts, column widths, row heights, drawings, embedded images stay identical to the reference. The sap-writer's only job is to produce a TR (translation) map; the helper writes the file.

  Pipeline for each Excel-output spec:

  1. **sap-writer produces the TR map** — a flat JSON object mapping every English source string in `asset/template_base.xlsx` to its target-language replacement for THIS program. Schema, slot semantics (5 parameter slots / 12 step slots / 10 output column slots / 5 auth rows / 3 exception rows), and the canonical key list are in [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md). Unused slots are filled with `— (해당 없음)` / `—` placeholders so the row count stays identical to the template. SAP standard identifiers (table names, field names, parameter names) that happen to match the source spec MUST be present in the TR map to remap them to the target program's identifiers; identifiers absent from TR remain unchanged.
  2. **Persist the TR map** to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed for review).
  3. **Run the template-clone helper**:
     ```bash
     node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json-path> <out-xlsx-path>
     ```
     The helper reads `asset/template_base.xlsx`, re-zips every entry byte-for-byte, replaces each `<t>…</t>` payload in `xl/sharedStrings.xml` using the TR map, and writes the output xlsx. Default output path is `.sc4sap/specs/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}-{lang}.xlsx`. Any English string lacking a TR entry is reported on stdout (`NO TRANSLATION:` lines) so the writer can patch the map and re-run.
  4. **Verify the artifact** — `ls` the output path (file size ≈ 90 KB), `unzip -l` lists `xl/sharedStrings.xml` plus the unchanged `xl/styles.xml`, `xl/worksheets/sheet1..7.xml`, `xl/drawings/drawing*.xml`, `xl/media/image1.png`, `xl/media/image2.png`. Open in Excel and scan every sheet — geometry MUST match `asset/template_base.xlsx` exactly.
  5. **Cleanup** — leave the TR JSON in place for traceability (it documents what was generated for this program). Remove only ephemeral files (HUD probes, smoke tests). Per-spec drivers do not exist anymore in this pipeline.

  **Zero external npm dependencies** — `template-clone.mjs` uses only `node:zlib` + `node:fs` + `node:path` + `node:url`. Works fully offline after `git clone` on networks that block `registry.npmjs.org`.

  **Sheet order is fixed by `asset/template_base.xlsx`** — clone never reorders. The template ships with:
  1. `프로그램 개요` / Program Overview — Field/Value metadata (17 rows)
  2. `데이터 모델` / Data Model — Table/Access/Key Fields/Join Type/Notes (4 table slots + trailer)
  3. `입력 및 화면` / Inputs & Screens — Parameters (5 slots) + 5 warning rows + 2 image anchors at C4 / C19
  4. `처리 로직` / Processing Logic — #/Event/Step (12 step slots) + Process Flow Chart heading
  5. `출력` / Output — Order/Field/Description/Length/Edit/Hidden (10 column slots)
  6. `권한` / Authorizations — Check/Object/Level/Implemented?/Notes (5 rows)
  7. `예외 처리` / Exceptions — Trigger/Mechanism/Message/Recovery (3 rows)

  **Styles, borders, fonts, fills, column widths, row heights — all preserved** from `asset/template_base.xlsx`. Do NOT rebuild them in drivers; do NOT introduce parallel `rich-xlsx-template.mjs` style constants. The reference workbook is the single source of truth.

  **Image anchors stay intact** — `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` anchors the two embedded images (Selection screen mockup at C4, ALV grid mockup at C19) on the `입력 및 화면` sheet. Swapping `sharedStrings.xml` does not touch drawings. To replace the embedded images for a specific program, see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task, not part of the default clone path).

-  - After a mini-frame (top-info panel, toolbar row, flow diagram, toolbar→BAPI block), always call `screenCloseFrame` before starting the next section, so every frame has a visible bottom edge.

Swapping `sharedStrings.xml` does not touch drawings. To replace the embedded images for a specific program, see [`spec-templates.md`](spec-templates.md) § Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task, not part of the default clone path).
-  - Low input: `F:H` (3 cols, merged, style 6 sky-blue)
-  - Range separator `~`: col `J` (single, style 7) — ONLY when SELECT-OPTIONS with range
-  - High input: `K:M` (3 cols, merged, style 6 sky-blue) — ONLY when SELECT-OPTIONS with range
-  - Note / default annotation: `O:P` (2 cols, merged, style 0)

-  - EVERY range parameter MUST use these exact columns so the high box visually aligns across rows. If a param has a dynamic default (e.g. PO-date `당월1일~오늘`), it STILL uses F:H + J separator + K:M high — NEVER shift one column left.

**Step 3.5 — Draw screens (MANDATORY when screens exist)**

Every Selection-Screen and every output Screen (Dynpro) / ALV must be rendered as a **visual wireframe**, not just described in prose. Use this tiered approach:

1. **ASCII wireframe** — **Markdown output only**. Works inside fenced code blocks where character widths are guaranteed uniform. **Never** put ASCII box-drawing characters (`┌─┐│└┘├┤┬┴┼`) into Excel cells — Excel column widths don't match character widths, so vertical lines misalign and the mock breaks visually. For Excel use real cell borders instead (see the Excel render pipeline in Step 4).
   - Reconstruct layout from `GetScreen` / `ReadScreen` (`HEADER` + `FLOW_LOGIC` + field positions `LINE` / `COLUMN` / `LENGTH` / `HEIGHT`) for Dynpros.
   - Reconstruct Selection-Screen from `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` / `SELECTION-SCREEN BLOCK` statements in the source.
   - Reconstruct ALV output from the field catalog (columns + widths + headings).
   - Show label + input box + F4-help marker `[▼]` + mandatory `*`.
2. **Embedded PNG mockup (v8.1 PRIMARY PATH for xlsx — all languages, L1~L4)** — **xlsx output**. Selection Screen and ALV layout are rendered as SVG → PNG **in parallel** (Promise.all → two concurrent headless-browser spawns) via `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` and embedded through `build({ images })` in `rich-xlsx-template.mjs`. **Drivers do not call the renderer directly** — they only populate `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` / `SHEET_TITLE` constants; the template's `buildImages()` helper + top-level `await` does the rest. `alv.maxRows` is **3 (absolute max 5)**. When rasterization returns null (no headless Edge/Chrome) or times out (30s cap), `screensSheet()` auto-draws cell-border wireframes from the same specs via `renderSelectionWireframe` / `renderAlvWireframe` — never silently omit the screens.
3. **Mermaid diagram** (MD output only, when flow matters):
   - `flowchart TD` for screen-to-screen navigation (CALL SCREEN / LEAVE TO / SET SCREEN).
   - `classDiagram` for GUI Status menubar/toolbar/function-key mapping.
   - In Excel, the same flow is drawn as style-21 bordered-box cells connected by plain-text arrows.
4. **Classical Dynpro** → include header line (short description, next-screen, cursor-pos) + flow-logic pseudo-code (`PBO` / `PAI` modules).
5. **GUI Status** → render menubar / application toolbar / function keys as a short table (FKEY → FCODE → text) plus (in MD) an ASCII toolbar bar.

Artifacts produced in this step are placed in the `Inputs & Screens` section (MD §8) or `Inputs & Screens` sheet (Excel). The **Parameters table (§8.1) is always rendered** — for objects without UI (pure class, FM, CDS, RAP without screens), skip only the wireframe tiers (§8.2–§8.4) and keep the Parameters table.

15

17	## 2. Data Model
18	| Table / CDS | Access | Key Fields | Notes |
19	## 3. Inputs & Screens
20	## 4. Main Logic (step-by-step)
21	## 5. Outputs

## Excel — Template-clone (양식 보존) workflow

The Excel output is produced by cloning `asset/template_base.xlsx` byte-for-byte and swapping only `xl/sharedStrings.xml`. The clone helper is `scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`. The sap-writer's deliverable is therefore a **TR (translation) map**, not a styled workbook.

### TR map schema

```jsonc
{
  "Program Overview (ZMMTEST003)": "프로그램 개요 (ZMMR1001)",
  "ZMMRTEST003":                   "ZMMR1001",
  "Object Type":                   "오브젝트 타입",
  "PROG/P (ABAP Report)":          "PROG/P (ABAP Report)",
  // … one entry per English source string in the template …
}
```

Flat object · key = English source string from `asset/template_base.xlsx` sharedStrings.xml · value = target-language replacement for THIS program. Persist to `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` (UTF-8, pretty-printed).

### Sheet layout (fixed by template_base — clone never reorders)

| # | Sheet (KO display) | Columns / rows in template |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 프로그램 개요 | Field / Value (17 metadata rows) |
| 2 | 데이터 모델 | Table / Access / Key Fields / Join Type / Notes — 4 table slots + CDS / BAPI / BAdI trailer rows |
| 3 | 입력 및 화면 | Parameters (5 slots) · 5 ⚠ warning rows · 2 image anchors (C4 = Selection mockup, C19 = ALV mockup) |
| 4 | 처리 로직 | # / Event / Step — 12 step slots + `Process Flow Chart` heading |
| 5 | 출력 | Order / Field / Field Description / Length / Edit / Hidden — 10 column slots |
| 6 | 권한 | Check / Auth Object / Level / Implemented? / Notes — 5 rows |
| 7 | 예외 처리 | Trigger / Mechanism / Message / Recovery — 3 rows |

### Slot semantics

When the target program has fewer items than the template's fixed slot count, **fill unused slots with placeholders** so row counts (and therefore borders, fills, styles) stay identical:

| Section | Template count | Placeholder convention |
|---|---|---|
| Sheet 3 Parameters | 5 (S_VKORG..S_VBELN) | `— (해당 없음)` for the field name, `—` for type/required/default, short note in the description |
| Sheet 3 Warnings | 5 ⚠ rows | Use real findings; if fewer than 5, repeat the most important caveat or summarise into 5 buckets |
| Sheet 4 Steps | 12 numbered rows | `— (해당 없음)` for the FORM name, brief explainer for the step text |
| Sheet 5 Output columns | 10 ALV column rows | `— (해당 없음)` for unused field, `—` for length |
| Sheet 6 Auth | 5 rows | Use real auth objects + GAP rows; rewire the 양식 row labels semantically when needed (e.g. `Sales Org row-level` → `플랜트 단위`) |
| Sheet 7 Exceptions | 3 rows | Combine if target has only 2; split if it has 4+ — keep the 3-row template count |

### SAP identifier remapping

Identifiers in the template (`ZMMRTEST003`, `VBAK`, `VBELN`, `S_VKORG`, etc.) MUST appear as TR keys mapping to the target program's identifiers when they differ (`ZMMR1001`, `MARA`, `MATNR`, `P_WERKS`). Identifiers absent from TR remain in the cloned file unchanged — that's the desired behaviour when the target shares the identifier with the template.

### Quality gates (before declaring done)

1. `node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json> <out-xlsx>` exits 0.
2. Stdout shows `NO TRANSLATION:` for ONLY the SAP standard identifiers the target program genuinely reuses (table names, field names common to both specs). Any prose / label / sheet-title / warning string missing from TR is a bug — patch and re-run.
3. `unzip -l <out-xlsx>` lists 32 entries identical to `asset/template_base.xlsx` (same names, similar sizes — only `xl/sharedStrings.xml` size differs).
4. Output file ≈ 90 KB.
5. Open in Excel — every sheet renders with identical geometry to `asset/template_base.xlsx`.

## Image Replacement (separate user-triggered task)

`asset/template_base.xlsx` ships two reference PNGs anchored on Sheet 3 (`입력 및 화면`):
- `xl/media/image2.png` (900×280) — Selection screen mockup, anchored at `<col>2</col><row>3</row>` (C4), ext `8572500 × 2667000` EMU.
- `xl/media/image1.png` (1020×184) — ALV grid mockup, anchored at `<col>2</col><row>18</row>` (C19), ext `9715500 × 1752600` EMU.

The default `program-to-spec` clone path leaves these images intact. To replace them with program-specific mockups, the user must explicitly request "이미지도 교체" / "regenerate the embedded images". When triggered, the replacement task:
1. Renders new Selection + ALV PNGs via `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (or any image source the user supplies).
2. Replaces `xl/media/image1.png` and `xl/media/image2.png` in the OUTPUT xlsx (not the template).
3. Leaves `xl/drawings/drawing3.xml` and its `_rels/drawing3.xml.rels` untouched — anchor positions and image-id mapping stay the same.
4. Re-zips.

This MUST stay a user-triggered step; never run it automatically as part of the default clone. Auto-replacement would re-introduce the drift problem the clone workflow exists to prevent.

- **Author / Changed**: {user} / {date}

## 2. Data Model
| Table / CDS | Access | Key Fields | Notes |

## 4. Main Logic (step-by-step)
## 5. Outputs
## 6. Authorizations
## 7. Exceptions & Messages
## 8. Dependencies (BAPIs, RFCs, enhancements)

### 8.1 Parameters
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

(Report → `PARAMETERS` / `SELECT-OPTIONS` · FM/Class → `IMPORTING` · CDS → view params · RAP → action inputs.
 Always rendered, even when the object has no UI screens.)
### 8.2 Selection-Screen 1000 (only if screens exist)
```
┌─ Open Sales Order (ZSDR_OPEN_ORDER_ALV) ──────────────────┐
│  * Sales Organization  [____] [▼]                          │
│  * Document Date       [__________] to [__________] [▼]    │
│    Sold-to Party       [__________] to [__________] [▼]    │

└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  [F8 Execute]  [F3 Back]  [Shift+F1 Variant]
```
### 8.3 Output — ALV 0100 (only if ALV/Dynpro output exists)
```
┌──────────┬──────────┬────────────┬──────────┬────────┬──────────┐
│ SalesOrd │ Item     │ Material   │ Qty      │ UoM    │ NetValue │
├──────────┼──────────┼────────────┼──────────┼────────┼──────────┤

└──────────┴──────────┴────────────┴──────────┴────────┴──────────┘

```mermaid
flowchart LR

  B -->|Double-click| C[VA03 VBAK]
```
## 9. Open Questions / Assumptions
```

## Excel — sheet naming convention

Sheets named in chosen language; example labels (English):
`Overview`, `Inputs & Screens`, `Data Model`, `Processing Logic`, `Output`, `Authorizations`, `Exceptions`, `Enhancement Points`, `Dependent Objects`, `Where-Used`, `Risk`.

The `Inputs & Screens` sheet (v8) is laid out top→bottom as: (1) sheet title, (2) Selection-Screen PNG anchored at B3, (3) ALV layout PNG anchored at B19 (≤ 3 sample rows, max 5), (4) Flow diagram, (5) BAPI / Action mapping, (6) Parameters table (`paramsBlock()` — datatype / required / default / description — always rendered), (7) yellow warning rows at the BOTTOM (Auth caveats + Data-volume caveats, style 20). Images are produced by `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` and embedded via `build({ images })`. Colors: grey + yellow only — green fill is retired. When no headless browser is available, degrade to cell-border wireframes via the `screen*` helpers in `rich-xlsx-template.mjs` — never silently omit the screens.

<Inputs_And_Screens_Rendering>
**Universal applicability (v8.1):** the image pipeline runs for **every xlsx spec** regardless of language (ko / en / ja / de / …) and depth (**L1 / L2 / L3 / L4**). Driver is language-agnostic — just populate `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` (+ optional `SHEET_TITLE`) constants at the top of the per-spec driver, and the template's internal `buildImages()` helper auto-imports `screen-image-renderer.mjs`, renders both PNGs, and embeds them via `build({ images })`. **No driver edits to the build call are required.**

**Parallel rendering:** `renderScreenImages()` in `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` uses `Promise.all` to spawn two headless browsers concurrently — Selection + ALV rasterize in parallel. Wall-clock cost is ~3s for both (vs ~6s sequential on Windows/Edge). Each branch is independent: if one rasterize fails or hits the 30s timeout, its PNG becomes null and the template falls back to cell-border wireframe for **that section only** — the other PNG still embeds, spec still opens.

**Fallback wireframe (auto):** when headless browser missing OR rasterize fails, `screensSheet()` in the template detects `hasSelectionImg` / `hasAlvImg` are false and draws cell-border wireframes from the same `SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC` / `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC` via `renderSelectionWireframe` / `renderAlvWireframe` — readers always see the layout, never an empty sheet.

Mandatory content rules (propagate to every per-spec driver):
- **ALV sample rows ≤ 3** (up to 5 only when demonstrating lock / edit / mixed-status variants). Never dump more — the image is a mockup, not a data extract.
- **Color palette = grey + yellow only**. Headers, title bars, table captions use **light grey** (fill 2). Yellow (fill 3 / style 20) is reserved for warning rows. Green fill is retired.
- **Yellow warning rows MUST sit at the BOTTOM** of the `Inputs & Screens` sheet — readers scan top→bottom.
- **Informational rows** (Flow diagram, BAPI / Action mapping) above the Parameters table use minimal formatting.
- **Localise `SHEET_TITLE` + `INPUTS_SHEET_NAME`** for ko/ja specs — `build()` warns (no silent drop) if `images[].sheetName` drifts from the final workbook sheet name.

Markdown output — unchanged: continue emitting ASCII wireframes inside fenced code blocks. ASCII wireframes never go in xlsx cells.
</Inputs_And_Screens_Rendering>

pages.content:
## 배경 / 문제

기존 `/sc4sap:program-to-spec` Excel 출력 경로는 매 회 **throwaway driver** 패턴(`scripts/spec/rich-xlsx-template.mjs` 1754 lines를 per-spec driver로 복사 → TODO 블록을 JSON으로 채움 → 실행 후 삭제)으로 workbook geometry(styles / borders / column widths / row heights / image anchors)를 JSON에서 매번 재구성했음.

반복 작업 결과 합의된 reference layout과 미세한 drift가 누적됨 — 컬럼 폭, 폰트, 셀 테두리, 이미지 앵커가 매 spec마다 조금씩 달라짐. 사용자가 "양식예시.xlsx 그대로 유지하고 내부 데이터만 바꾸면 된다"고 지적.

## 변경 내용

### 새 자산 (2개)

- **`asset/template_base.xlsx`** (90 KB) — 영문 reference workbook (ZMMRTEST003 spec). 모든 sheet geometry / styles / borders / 폰트 / column widths / row heights / drawings / embedded images의 영구 single source of truth. 이전 파일명 `양식예시.xlsx` → `asset/` 폴더로 이동 및 리네임.
- **`scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs`** (208 lines, zero npm deps) — `asset/template_base.xlsx`를 byte-for-byte 클론하고 `xl/sharedStrings.xml`만 TR(translation) 맵으로 교체하는 헬퍼. `node:zlib` + `node:fs` + `node:path` + `node:url`만 사용 (오프라인 SAP 고객망 호환).

### 문서 업데이트 (3개)

- **`skills/program-to-spec/SKILL.md`** — `<Agent_Composition>`에서 sap-writer의 deliverable을 **TR map** (English source string → 한국어 replacement)로 변경. `<Inputs_And_Screens_Rendering>` 섹션을 양식 보존 방식으로 재작성. 
- **`skills/program-to-spec/workflow-steps.md`** (152 → 101 lines) — Step 4 (Render) 완전 재작성. throwaway driver pipeline → template-clone pipeline. Step 3.5 (Draw screens)도 Markdown-only로 축소 (xlsx는 template_base의 기본 이미지를 사용).
- **`skills/program-to-spec/spec-templates.md`** (63 → 104 lines) — TR map JSON 스키마, 7개 sheet slot 의미 (5 params / 12 steps / 10 cols / 5 auth / 3 exc), placeholder 컨벤션 (`— (해당 없음)`), Image Replacement 별도 task 가이드.

### 정리된 자산 (3개 제거)

- `scripts/spec/rich-xlsx-template.mjs` (1754 lines) — 새 path에서 미사용
- `scripts/spec/build-xlsx.mjs` (225 lines) — 옛 minimal writer, 미사용
- `CHANGE_ME.xlsx` — 옛 driver 부산물

### 보존된 자산

- `scripts/spec/screen-image-renderer.mjs` (1064 lines) — 이미지 교체 task에서 재사용 예정

## 새 워크플로우 (Excel 출력)

1. sap-writer → TR JSON 생성 (key=영문 source string, value=한국어 target string)
2. `.sc4sap/specs/_tr/{OBJECT}-{YYYYMMDD}.tr.json` 저장
3. `node scripts/spec/template-clone.mjs <tr-json> <out-xlsx>` 실행
4. 검증: 파일 ≈ 90 KB · `unzip -l` 32 entries · sharedStrings.xml만 변경되고 styles/sheets/drawings/media는 byte-identical
5. `NO TRANSLATION:` 경고는 SAP 표준 식별자(공유 테이블/필드명)만 허용

## 검증 결과

- `ZMMR1001-20260521-ko.xlsx` (91 KB, 7 sheets, 2 embedded PNGs at C4/C19) — 양식 100% 보존 확인.
- `ZMMRTEST003-20260520-ko.xlsx` 재생성 — geometry 동일.
- Smoke test (4-key TR로 새 path 호출) → 91 KB 출력, sharedStrings 교체 정상.

## Follow-up

- **이미지 임베드 교체** — 기본 클론 경로는 template_base의 두 PNG (Selection screen mockup at C4, ALV grid at C19)를 그대로 사용. "이미지도 교체" 사용자 요청 시에만 `xl/media/image1.png` + `image2.png` 교체 (드로잉/앵커는 유지). 별도 task로 진행.
- **다른 언어 (en / ja / de)** — TR map의 value만 해당 언어로 작성하면 동일 path 재사용 가능.

## 참조

- 회의 발단: 사용자가 ZMMRTEST003 spec 생성 시 "양식예시 서식 그대로 지정한뒤에 내부 데이터만 바꾸면 되는데" 지적 (2026-05-20).
- 사용자 명시 요청: "양식예시.xlsx 파일 이름 template_base.xlsx 로 변경하고 ... asset 폴더 만들고 그 안으로 위치 이동" (2026-05-21).

template_base.xlsx에 기본 임베드된 두 PNG는 program-agnostic mockup이라 ≥95% 케이스 충분하지만, 프로그램별 실제 화면 mockup으로 교체하고 싶을 때 다음 절차:

1	- [200-line hard cap for sc4sap rule/spec files](feedback_200_line_cap.md) — skills/agents/common/phase 파일 201 라인이면 무조건 토픽 기준 split + `wc -l` 검증 + 못 줄이면 STOP 경고
2	- [program-to-spec default opener = bundled 4-Q AskUserQuestion](feedback_program_to_spec_opener.md) — object-in-args면 Audience/Format/Depth/Language를 한 번에 single-select 번들로 질의 (Recommended 첫 옵션)
3	- [program-to-spec xlsx = NO cell truncation](feedback_xlsx_no_truncation.md) — v4 템플릿 defaults(PAD6/MAX100/WRAP55/B..P=14) 유지 + screensSheet per-cell 부등식 `VW+2 ≤ (cols)×14` 검증 + Step 4b QA 의무
4	- [program-to-spec xlsx v5 색상·시트순서·ALV헤더 규칙](feedback_xlsx_style_v5.md) — 연한초록(#E2EFDA)+bold 헤더 · 연한하늘(#DDEBF7) 입력 · Inputs&Screens=시트 3번째 · ALV헤더 `필드 설명/길이` · Selection param row B:E/F:H/I/J/K:M/N/O:P 정렬
5	- [program-to-spec xlsx v6 col-A 회색 + 테두리 연속성](feedback_xlsx_style_v6.md) — screens sheet col A 옅은회색 · style 17 TLR→ALL · screenFrameRow/screenSubtitleRow/screenMerge 모듈 헬퍼 의무 사용 (일부 v7에서 교정됨)
6	- [program-to-spec xlsx v7 첫 행 회색 + merge 테두리 복원](feedback_xlsx_style_v7.md) — row 1(style 2)이 회색 · col A 회색 제거 · screenMerge/FullRow/SubtitleRow는 병합 전체 셀에 스타일 세팅해야 Excel이 outer 사각형 완전 렌더 (v6 top-left-only 회귀 수정)
7	- [program-to-spec xlsx v8 이미지 embed + 회색 팔레트](feedback_xlsx_style_v8.md) — Selection+ALV=PNG(B3/B19 anchor via screen-image-renderer.mjs) · grey+yellow 팔레트(초록 폐기, styles 3/4/17/19/24 → fill 2) · ALV 샘플 ≤3(max 5) · 경고행 시트 맨 아래
8	- [program-to-spec xlsx v9 flowchart + per-sheet colWidths + 정확한 row heights](feedback_xlsx_processflow_v9.md) — (1) `PROCESS_FLOW`로 Processing Logic 시트에 박스/결정/종료 + ↓ 자동 렌더, (2) `SHEETS_DATA[].colWidths`로 명시 너비 + 연속 동폭 그룹핑, (3) 헤더 22.5/2-line 33.75/3-line 51/4-line 67.5 lookup table, (4) Sheet 3 col F=50.71 + warning row ht=22.5, (5) 사용자 명시 요청은 임의 판단으로 보류 금지
9	- [program-to-spec xlsx v10 ALV_IMAGE_SPEC multi-pane (Split-ALV / Tabstrip)](feedback_xlsx_multipane_alv_v10.md) — `ALV_IMAGE_SPEC.panes[]` 채우면 multi-pane 합성 PNG (각 pane = title bar + grid, 사이에 ↓ interaction caption) · **모든 pane은 realistic sampleRows 필수** (placeholder는 last-resort) · pane title 에 trigger 컨텍스트(예: "상단 HALB-001234 클릭 시") 명시 · interaction=WHEN/HOW, sampleRows=WHAT · legacy 단일 grid shape 그대로 호환 · SCREENS_FLOW (추가 dynpro/subscreen) 는 v10b 차후
10	- [specs 폴더 최종 상태 = xlsx만](feedback_specs_folder_xlsx_only.md) — program-to-spec 종료 시 `_drivers/`·`_smoke/`·HUD 부산물(`.sc4sap/.hud-*.json`) 모두 `rm -rf` · specs 최상위엔 .xlsx만
11	- [git exclude .claude folder](feedback_git_exclude_claude.md) — `.claude/`는 개인 로컬 설정이라 add/commit/push 제외 · `.gitignore` 추가 확인 · merge 충돌 시 ours 자동 해결
12	- [entire CLI 동작 + 체크포인트 분기 정확히](feedback_entire_checkpoints.md) — `entire status` enabled (= `entire enable` + hooks 설치)일 때만 자동 추적 · `entire attach`는 일회성 스냅샷이라 이후 새 커밋엔 미연결 (수동 trailer 필요) · git 체크포인트 브랜치(v<N>)는 status가 not-enabled 일 때 또는 사용자 명시 요청시 푸시
13	- [main 브랜치 절대 금지](feedback_never_touch_main_branch.md) — main / origin/main 은 push·checkout·merge·rebase·base 전부 금지 · 기본 배포 타깃은 `origin/active` · 실수 직전엔 STOP 하고 사용자에게 확인
14	- [커밋 author = tennto s2hoon326@gmail.com](feedback_commit_author_tennto.md) — 모든 커밋은 ephemeral `-c user.name="tennto" -c user.email="s2hoon326@gmail.com"` · 리포 기존 author (babamba2/psspss1122) 절대 따라가지 말 것
15	- [스킬 전용 helper/렌더링 지시는 generic agent의 dispatch + 본문 양쪽 모두 금지](feedback_dispatch_prompt_helper_leak.md) — sap-writer 같은 multi-skill agent의 (a) dispatch 프롬프트, (b) agents/<name>.md 본문 어느 쪽에도 특정 스킬 전용 helper(screensSheet/SELECTION_IMAGE_SPEC) 또는 스킬 전용 렌더링 지시(스크린 PNG 렌더 등) 박지 말 것 · 본문에 박는 게 dispatch보다 더 심각(opt-out 불가) · 계약은 오직 스킬 workflow 문서에만 · program-to-spec은 owner 영역이라 명시 지목시에만 손대기
16	- [paramsBlock 외곽 프레임 하단 닫기 (BL/BR)](feedback_params_block_close_frame.md) — data-rows 루프 후 마지막 행의 col A(style 9, left-only)·col Q(style 10, right-only)에 bottom 없어 외곽 사각형 하단 두 코너가 열림 → `cells[R(closeRow-1,0)]={s:15}; cells[R(closeRow-1,16)]={s:16}` 로 BL/BR 덮어씌워 닫기
